basis: MSI CostFinalize resolves directory properties with a trailing separator. On standard Windows command-line parsing, a quoted trailing single backslash escapes the closing quote. This can make the argv path malformed and fail a legitimate fresh install. Pure static checks did not establish actual argv execution.
nativeContract: Compare this untrusted resolved main-file fact only against OS KnownFolder fixed root.join(fc-bootstrap.exe); do not derive root/open caller path/accept literal quote.
